prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE DESIGN BOARD with3 independently labeled specimens of the real anonymous GUEST PUBLIC EDITOR unsaved-leave confirmation dialog: external labels DESIGN BOARD, A Desktop, B390px, C320px. No phone/browser/private host/owner rail or editor toolbar. PILOT STYLE ONLY: flat white/light-gray, clear dark/muted text, thin lines,8px radii and restrained shadow; no copied private content. Natural readable type, board around1536×900, no tiny thumbnails; A dialog natural500px wide, B fits390viewport, C fits320viewport with text/actions wrapping and no lost fields.
All3 represent SAME source-derived dirty CLOSE variant, confirmation='close', not reload, not saving/loading. Actual NModal title 当前编辑尚未保存; closeX enabled (dismisses confirmation, keeps draft). Exact body 返回阅读会放弃当前未保存的编辑。请先复制需要保留的内容。 Exact actions 保留编辑 neutral enabled and 放弃编辑并返回阅读 danger OUTLINED enabled. No Save button, no 放弃编辑并重新载入 (other variant), no reload/server-error/body-content field, no private owner toolbar/path/tokens, no login/password. This is a custom in-app dialog, not browser beforeunload chrome. Public guest capability/CSRF/CAS guards remain invisible source contracts. Keep mobile primary/secondary actions reachable; no simultaneous alternative dialogs or role mixing.

responsiveFamily.reuseRule: Exact shared wrapper/renderer CSS structure is the responsive reference. Each source keeps its exact field order, inner overflow/focus/guard binding in responsiveMappings and its full desktop/dense-form master. This does not assert distinct labels/data or incompatible states are all visible here.
